tei:div.tei:p: ka rtags/tshan grangs/le tshan so so'i mtshan/rtsom pa po/yig gzugs/ldeb grangs/ldeb tshad/cm

nang 1 000001 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dka' gnad mdor bsdus pa nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/shing dpar/ 5153¿8|5 nang 2 000002 'dul ṭika nyi ma'i 'od zer legs bshad lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho las dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed zhu ba spyir bstan gzhi smad dang bcas pa bzhugs so/kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po/shing dpar/ 21962¿10 nang 3 000003 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer legs bshad lung gi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/kun makyen mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po/shing dpar/ 42364¿11 nang 3 000004 'dul ṭīka nyi ma'i 'od zer legs bshad lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho las dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed zhu ba spyir bstan gzhi smad dang bcas pa bzhugs so/kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po/shing dpar/ 21964¿11 nang 4 000005 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer legs bshad lung gi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po/shing dpar/ 21960¿11da5 nang 7 000009 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i mchan 'grel mthong ba don ldan ces bya ba kun mkhyen po mtsho sna bas mdzad pa bzhugs so/mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang po/shing dpar/ 39361da5¿10 nang 9 000011 las brgya rtsa gcig gi rnam par bshad pa cho ga'i gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/dge slong rin chen grub/shing dpar/ 14752¿8 nang 10 000014 las brgya rtsa gcig gi rnam par bshad pa cho ga'i gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/bu ston rin chen grub/shing dpar/ 14753¿6 nang 11 000018 'dul ba'i sdom tshig don gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/rnam rgyal shing dpar/ 3861¿10|3 nang 13 000022 bstan bcos chen po dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal gyi dka' gnad gsal bar byed pa'i spyi don legs bshad skal bzang mgul rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so/rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/shing dpar/

20562¿9 nang 14 000026 theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan gyi gzhung 'grel kun bzang mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros/shing dpar/ 8762¿11 nang 14 000027 bstan bcos chen mo dbu ma 'jug pa'i spyi thal 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros kyi gsung rgyun zin bris su bkod pa bzhugs so/'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros/shing dpar/ 19362¿11 nang 14 000028 rten 'brel gyi rnam bshad thar pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so/'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i lo gros/shing dpar/ 12362¿10 nang 15 000029 dbu ma la 'jug pa'i tshig don rnam par dbye ba'i brgal lan skal bzang rna rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/'jam dbyangs dga' blos mdzad/shing dpar/ 6062¿11 nang 15 000030 dbu ma rtsa ba'itshig le'ur byas pa'i gzhung 'grel rigs pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzing zhes bya ba bzhugs so/'jam dbyangs dga' blos mdzad/shing dpar/ 8262¿11 nang 15 000031 dbu ma la 'jug pa'i gzhung 'grel dgongs pa rab gsal bzhugs so/'jam dbyangs dga' blos mdzad/shing dpar/ 5762¿11 nang 19 000039 lung ston pa ka lā pa'i mdo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/shing dpar/ 2753¿9 nang 23 000057 dbu ma rtsa ba'i mchod brjod kyi tshig 'grel bzhugs so/bsod nams ming can gyis bris/shing dpar/ 653¿9 nang 68 000161 rje btsun red mda' ba'i gsung yig bzhugs pa lags so/rje btsun red mda' ba shing dpar/ 552¿8 nang 75 000169 dpang lo tsā chen pos mdzad pa'i brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi snying po gsal ba rang 'grel brda sprod snying po ches cher gsal ba dang bcas pa bzhugs so/dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/shing dpar/ 10856¿10 nang 90 000209 gzhi'i sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag rab gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros/shing dpar/

1853¿9 nang 97 000249 rgya skad bris pa'i yi ge'i klag thabs 'phags yul mkhas pa'i lugs bzhugs so/jo nang tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 454¿9da5 nang 98 000263 dpal sdom drug pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud dpal mo mkha' dpyod dga' ma'i nye lam mchog dpal ldan sa skya'i bla chen gser chos gang dpal mchog he ru ka dpal tshar pa rje gsung gi bcud 'di 'di phyir phan 'dod rnams brtson pas sgrub na na rga 'chi ba las nges par legs 'grol grol ba mchog 'grub pas zin bris 'di yang yang dag lam chen yin mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nyams len bzhugs so/ i thī shing dpar/ 3560¿9 nang 101 000281 chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i 'grel pa mngon pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/mchims nam mkha' grags pa/shing dpar/ 24658¿10 nang 103 000289 bka' gdams kyi rnam thar bka' gdams chos 'byung gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan/shing dpar/ 41753¿9|5 nang 104 000296 bsdus sbyor gyi snying po kun bsdus rig pa'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rdo rje/shing dpar/ 1154¿8|5 nang 106 000322 bya bral rnal 'byor pa zhig gis mdo sngags chos rnams thob pa'i thob yig thar pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/kun dga' snying pos mdzad/shing dpar/ 9257¿10 nang 107 000326 kha che pan+ṭi ta chen po shākya shri'i rnam thar legs pa bzhugs/dpe tshugs/ 844|5¿9 nang 112 000386 lta ba'i khrid yig de nyid gsal byed ces bya ba 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so/'jam dbyangs dga' blos mdzad/ shing dpar/ 1053¿11 nang 112 000390 legs par dpyad pa tshad ma rig pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so/dge slong don grub dpal gyis mdzad/dpe tshugs/ 7166¿9 nang 114 000396 yi ge'i brda gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos rin po che'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/shākya'i btsun pa sa skya pan+ṭi ta/shing dpar/

655¿10 nang 114 000397 slob dpon a ṇus mdzad pa'i bod kyi skad kyi gsung rab la 'jug tshul sum cu pa'i rnam 'grel bzhugs/zha lu lo tsā ba dge slong dharma pa la bha dra/shing dpar/ 1458¿10 nang 114 000400 byā ka ra ṇa'i rtags kyi 'jug pa rnam par gsal ba'i legs bshad bzhugs so/zhwa lu chos skyong bzang po/shing dpar/ 1856¿9 nang 125 000483 bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod bzhugs/bu ston rinachen grub shing dpar/ 18951¿9 nang 126 000492 gnod sbyin bshan pa lcam dral gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ha la nag po dug gi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so/tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/dpe tshugs/ 1450¿9 nang 128 000537 rje btsun seng ge'i sgra dang phyag rdor la brten pa'i sa bdag 'don 'grol byed tshul gsung sel nor bu'i zla ba zhes bya ba'i lag len phyogs sgrigs yang gsal bzhugs so/spang lung blo bzang thugs rje brtson 'grus/shing dpar/ 2154¿8|5 nang 129 000546 bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas skra dang rus chog bya ba'i cho ga bzhugs/blun rgan bstan skyong gis/shing dpar/ 655¿9 nang 136 000601 legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba bzhugs/sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/dpe tshugs/ 2347da5¿7da5 nang 149 000655 gzhi'i sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag rab gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros/shing dpar/ 2853¿8 nang 150 000660 rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa skyes bu gsum gyi man ngag gi khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/jo nang tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 5754¿8 nang 151 000666 sdom pa nyi shu pa sogs kyi mtshan 'grel dang bcas pa'i byang sems kyi bslab bya mdor bsdus bzhugs so/spang lung blo bzang thugs rjes mdzad/shing dpar/

1155¿10 nang 152 000669 dpal ldan zhwa lu pa'i bstan pa la bka' drin che ba'i skyes bu rnams kyi rnam thar lo rgyus ngo mtshar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/zhwa lu ba blo gsal bstan skyong shing dpar/ 23654|5¿10|2 nang 155 000677 grub mtha' kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma le'u dang po ka pa nas bcu gcig pa cha pa'i bar tshan 6bzhugs/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/shing dpar/ 45163¿11 nang 158 000685 rdor sems kyi khrid rgyas bsdus gnyis dang sngags kyi ltung ba bshags tshul rdor rje theg pa'i dam tshig gi rnam gzhag thun drug gi rnal 'byor gyi sdom tshig sogs bzhugs so/lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan/shing dpar/ 954¿9 nang 159 000696 bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bshes pa'i springs yig gi 'grel pa don gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu blo gros/shing dpar/ 6161¿12 nang 165 000716 stag tshang lo ts+tsha ba'i brgal lan rdo rje'i zegs ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/gtsang stag tshang gi lo ts+tsha ba dge slong shes rab rin chen rgya mtsho/shing dpar/ 4152¿8 nang 183 000864 rgyud sde bzhi las gsungs pa'i yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas bzhugs so/tā ra nā thas/shing dpar/ 3557 nang 183 000865 sgrubs thabs brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal byed ces bya bzhugs so/mdzad pa po mi gsal/shing dpar/ 2752¿10 nang 183 000869 phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag ji snyed shes bya'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/go rams pa bsod nams seng ges/shing dpar/ 5952¿9 nang 185 000895 rje btsun 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma rigs gsum la brtan pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga rab dkar zla zhun gsar ba bzhugs so/spang lung blo bzang thugs rje/shing dpar/ 453¿9 nang 185 000896 rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig dbyangs can lha mo drag mo'igazugs can dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la brten pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gdung ba kun sel zla ba'i 'od zer/spang lung blo bzang thugs rje/shing dpar/

454¿9 nang 188 000993 gsang 'dus 'phags skor las rim lnga 'gos lugs kyi khrid yig rgyud don gsal ba/jo nang tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 2251|5¿8|3 nang 208zab mo dbu ma'i lta khrid kyi zin bris chos ldan rab 'byams gyis mdzad pa bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so/chos ldan rab 'byams pa/dpe tshugs/ 1259¿10 nang 211dpal rta mgrin yang gsang gi nyams len zab gnas kyi smon lam gyi rim pa bzhugs so/'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/shing dpar/ 553¿8|5 nang 275dus 'khor ṭīka chen las sgrub thabs le'u'i 'grel bshad blo gros cho skyong gis mdzad pa bzhugs so/g.yag sde blo gros chos skyong*/ drung blo gros chos skyong*/shing dpar/ 14755¿10 nang 280rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i deb gter shin tu zhib mo ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /dge legs 'phel/jo nang tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 7248¿9 nang 311theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gzhan don don gnyer gyi gdams pa'i rtsa ba bzhugs so/blo gros rgyal mtshan/shing dpar/ 62¿10 nang 311theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gzhan don gnyer gyi 'grel pa theg chen rab gsal zhes bya ba/blo gros rgyal mtshan/shing dpar/ 14962¿10 nang 311glang ri thang pa'i blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma smon lam du byas pa bzhugs so/blo gros rgyal mtshan/shing dpar/ 1161¿9 nang 311bla ma rnams la bstod pa dang bka' shog 'phrin yig gi skor bzhugs so/blo gros rgyal mtshan/shing dpar/ 2661¿9 nang 311sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa zab mo spros med ces bya ba bzhugs so/blo gros rgyal mtshan/shing dpar/ 861¿9 nang 313dam pa'i chos rin po che 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gsal bar ston pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/jo nang tā ra na thā/shing dpar/ 14056¿9 nang 313bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/bu ston rin chen grub/shing dpar/

21256¿10 nang 314rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin du yi ger bkod pa skabs brgyad pa'i spyi don bzhugs/shing dpar/ 766¿10 nang 352sngags kyi bklag thabs bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/snar thang lo tsā ba sang gha shrī shing dpar/ 453¿8 nang 352na ro chos drug gi khrid dmigs kyi bsdus don yid ches gsum ldan gyi snying po gsang ba'i mdzod brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/shar chen yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan/shing dpar/ 955¿10 nang 353sngags kyi bklag thabs bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/snar thang lo tsā ba sagha shrī shing dpar/ 453¿8 nang 354grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/shing dpar/ 1753¿9 nang 361dpal sa skya pa'i gces pa btus pa rin chen phreng ba bzhugs so/sa skya pan+ṭi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/dpe tshugs/ 3048¿8|5 nang 361rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras drag byed khros pa'i phrin las sgrub tshul 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs bzhugs so/ban 'khyams rin chen rgyal mtshan/shing dpar/ 546¿8 nang 381dpang lo chen pos mdzad pa'i tshogs gsum gsal ba bzhugs/dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa/shing dpar/ 1856¿10 nang 397zab don nyer gcig pa bzhugs so/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 1753¿10 nang 397dgyes rdor gyi rdzogs rim lhan cig skyes pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa bzhugs/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 2353¿10 nang 397dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/shing dpar/ 5353¿10 nang 397rdo rje gdan bzhi'i khrid yig ye shes sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 2853¿10 nang 397dpal gtum po khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba bla med kyi sgrub thabs bdud las rnam rgyal bzhugs/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/

953¿10 nang 397dpal 'khor lo chen po'i sgrub thabs srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba bzhugs/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 1153¿10 nang 397dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil chog srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba bzhugs/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 3153¿10 nang 397ni gu'i khrid yig bsdus pa bzhugs so/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 754¿10 nang 397gtor chog khams gsum zil gnon gyi lhan thabs rnge'u thung gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos zhes bya ba bzhugs/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 1854¿10 nang 397sbyin bsreg 'bring po zhes bya ba bzhugs/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 554¿10 nang 397rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'khrid yig mthong ba don ldan lhan thabs 'od brgya 'bar ba bzhugs/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/ 17954¿10 nang 397dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi byung tshul nyer mkho bzhugs/tā ra nā tha/shing dpar/
